residual.wall: ARAP-from-pearl is not a paddle. Pearl rest metric forbids a shaft. Independent KV is not ARAP. The solver must walk φ toward a target embedding, then restore local rigidity in that embedding’s metric.

question: What is the exact ARAP implementation on Gasper’s 25×40, which rest metric is lawful for a paddle, and what is one 60 fps tick?
coordinateSpaces: φ, φ*, φ̄ ∈ R² content-px. i=r*40+s. Sector wraps. Ring 0 is the pole (one point). L is 1000×1000 sparse, factored once per rest. Face lock v∈[0.32,0.58]. dt=1/60 s.
physicalLaw: ARAP rest φ̄ is the current target embedding φ*, not the pearl, when the morph changes metric (paddle, remote).
Pearl as φ̄ is lawful only for small handles on the pearl (puff, slap, gait). It cannot grow a shaft.
2D Kabsch: θ_i=atan2(S21-S12, S11+S22), R_i=[[c,-s],[s,c]], S=Σ_j w_ij (φ_i-φ_j)(φ̄_i-φ̄_j)^T.
Global: L φ = b, L_ii=Σ w_ij, L_ij=-w_ij, b_i=Σ_j (w_ij/2)(R_i+R_j)(φ̄_i-φ̄_j). Dirichlet rows = identity.
Tick: φ ← φ+k(φ*-φ) with k=1-exp(-dt/τ_i), then one local+global. Face verts Dirichlet to φ*.
w_ij=1/||φ̄_i-φ̄_j|| on 4-neighbors (ring±1, sector±1 wrap). Pole: 40 sectors share one φ.
artisticLaw: Blade cells stay rigid in the paddle metric. Handle stretch lives in φ*, not in ARAP.
Face lock is Dirichlet, not a fade. Eyes do not ride the shaft.
Gel is one ARAP step of leftover strain after KV, not a paint.
invariants: 1000 verts, 960 quads, connectivity frozen. Ring 0 collapsed to 1 DOF.
φ=φ*=φ̄ ⇒ ARAP is identity. Rest pearl + zero morph ⇒ Γ(L).
L depends only on φ̄. Refactor when morph changes. Never per frame.
det F_q > 0.15 after a tick. No remesh.
Hull and grid read the same φ[2000].
failureModes: φ̄=pearl during paddle: ARAP shortens the shaft back into a nub.
Full Dirichlet on all 1000: ARAP is a no-op; we are back to a blend shape.
Dense 1000×1000 invert every frame: miss 60 fps.
3D SVD per vertex: wasted; SO(2) is atan2.
Two writers: stance sockets after φ. The pearl returns.
uncertainty: One local-global per frame vs two. Throat quality is the unknown.
Uniform vs cotangent weights on a polar grid.
Whether gait should be a soft handle on two rim verts or a separate posed pass.
tests: Pearl rest + zero morph: φ equals restPolarMesh.
Paddle: φ̄ is paddle mesh; rim max y>blade+20; face |φ|<40.
Poke: displace 1 free vert 8px, one tick, neighbors move, face lock |Δ|<2px.
No edge > 2.4× rest length. All 960 det F > 0.15.
visualConsequences: Paddle hold is rigid gel, not a UV fan stacked on the blade rim.
A poke near the cheek ripples; the face plate stays.
Grid and hull are the same φ.
